entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: There she is! That's Chiyo Tsumano![n]According to what we dug up...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: "It's plagiarism if you trace art and publish it[n]as your own," "The popularity was putting pressure[n]on her" and...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: "She looked stressed in an interview"![n]Let's convince her and change of heart!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Are you Chiyo Tsumano?

entries.speaker: Tsumano
entries.en: Wooow, what an interesting outfit![n]Maybe I'll use it in my manga!

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Tsumano-san, why are you plagiarizing?[n]Tell me your reasons!

entries.speaker: Tsumano
entries.en: That voice... Kitagawa!? Now you're[n]accusing me of plagiarism too!?

entries.speaker: Tsumano
entries.en: You guys are the ones coming in here to[n]steal things! That's unforgivable!

entries.speaker: Shadow Tsumano
entries.en: I got scared when people started saying I[n]was a popular high school manga artist...

entries.speaker: Shadow Tsumano
entries.en: The more I tried to write things solely for[n]other people's enjoyment, the harder it[n]became to write...

entries.speaker: Shadow Tsumano
entries.en: I thought people wouldn't notice if it[n]was only a little bit, so I plagiarized...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You let the temptation get the better of[n]you when you were under pressure.

entries.speaker: Shadow Chiyo
entries.en: I wasn't caught, so I did it again and again...[n]But I got carried away, and now I can't turn[n]back.

entries.speaker: Shadow Chiyo
entries.en: The undeserved popularity must have[n]gone to my head...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I'm not familiar with manga. I have no[n]idea if you have what it takes to become[n]a manga artist.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: H-Hey, Yusuke...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: But I could feel the emotions of your[n]characters through your drawings.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Being able to convey emotion through art...[n]Is that not talent?

entries.speaker: Shadow Chiyo
entries.en: Me, talented...? I don't know...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I think you do. You were able to draw[n]without plagiarizing up until you got[n]popular, right?

entries.speaker: Shadow Chiyo
entries.en: ...I love manga. I want to draw it for[n]the rest of my life if I can...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Then you must atone for your sins.[n]For your own sake, if no one else's.

entries.speaker: Shadow Chiyo
entries.en: Yeah, you're right... I'll stop plagiarizing.[n]And I'll apologize to everyone, too...

entries.speaker: Shadow Chiyo
entries.en: Phantom Thieves, please. Change my weak[n]heart...
Of course.
Let's start over.

entries.speaker: Shadow Chiyo
entries.en: I'm going to stop running away and do the[n]best I can.
